papers.title: Eclipse Observables for Navigation in Cislunar Space
papers.summary: Autonomous navigation independent of Earth-based tracking remains a challenge for spacecraft operating in cislunar space. This paper proposes onboard eclipse detection as an opportunistic measurement set to supplement the state estimation of cislunar trajectories. Penumbral and umbral entry and exit times detected from standard power telemetry are formulated as implicit zero-measurements on the boundaries of second-order shadow cones computed from planetary ephemerides. These observables are processed in an unscented Kalman filter. The event-time uncertainty that weights each measurement is derived from physical sources excluded in the spherical body model, including telemetry sampling, Earth's atmosphere, and topography/oblateness of the occulting body. The approach is demonstrated both in simulation for an $L_1$ halo orbit and with flight telemetry and orbit determination products from the CAPSTONE spacecraft during the January 2026 lunar eclipse, where umbral contacts timed directly from the power telemetry agree with the geometric contacts to within one sample interval. In both cases, hardware-free eclipse event timing shows utility in uncertainty reduction, especially as the initial solution quality is degraded.
papers.title_ja: シスルナ空間におけるナビゲーションのための日食観測可能量
papers.summary_ja: シスルナ空間での自律ナビゲーションを支援するため、機上での日食検出を機会的な観測量として活用する手法を提案する。標準的な電力テレメトリから検出された半影・本影の出入り時刻を、惑星暦から計算される2次円錐影の境界における暗黙のゼロ観測量として定式化し、無香カルマンフィルタで処理する。観測量の重み付けには、テレメトリサンプリングや地球大気・地形などの物理的誤差源を考慮したイベント時刻の不確実性を導出する。L1ハロー軌道のシミュレーションと、CAPSTONE衛星の2026年1月の月食時の飛行テレメトリを用いた検証により、初期解の品質が劣化した場合でも不確実性の低減に有効であることを示した。

papers.title: Local Lyapunov Exponent-Guided Stochastic Midcourse Correction Design of Low-Energy Earth-Moon Transfers
papers.summary: Midcourse correction is essential for reliable cislunar transfer missions. For low-energy Earth-Moon transfers, strongly nonuniform error growth makes conventional correction strategies less effective. This paper proposes a stochastic midcourse correction design for low-energy Earth-Moon transfers based on local Lyapunov exponent (LLE). The local error-amplification characteristics of the nominal trajectory are first analyzed using an instantaneous LLE. The analysis shows that strong sensitivity is concentrated near periapsis, and that the LLE maxima coincide with regions of strong finite-time error growth. These maxima are therefore used to segment the trajectory and define the number of corrections. Based on this segmentation, a reduced parameterization is introduced to describe the correction epochs, while second-order state transition tensors (STTs) are employed for nonlinear correction targeting. The resulting timing variables are then optimized through a sample-average approximation of the chance-constrained stochastic problem. Paired Monte Carlo simulations show that, under the same mission-accuracy requirements, the proposed strategy greatly improves the reliability and robustness of trajectory recovery while requiring less correction cost than the classical Breakwell spacing-ratio strategy.
papers.title_ja: 局所リャプノフ指数に基づく低エネルギー地球-月間遷移の確率的中間軌道修正設計
papers.summary_ja: 低エネルギー地球-月間遷移において、局所リャプノフ指数（LLE）を用いて軌道の感度特性を分析し、修正タイミングを最適化する手法を提案する。LLEの最大値に基づいて軌道を分割し、修正回数を決定するとともに、2次状態遷移テンソル（STT）を用いた非線形ターゲットリングと確率制約付き最適化を適用する。モンテカルロシミュレーションの結果、従来のBreakwell間隔比戦略と比較して、同じ精度要件下で信頼性と頑健性を大幅に向上させ、かつ修正コストを削減できることを示した。
papers.relevance_reason: 軌道力学・低エネルギー遷移・最適化手法の組み合わせであり、関心領域と高度に一致

papers.title: Tractable Inference with Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks
papers.summary: Machine-learning surrogates in computational science often require not only accurate predictions but also expectations, variances, conserved integrals, and normalization constants. Conventional neural networks, including Kolmogorov--Arnold networks (KANs), generally evaluate these quantities through Monte Carlo sampling or multidimensional quadrature, making repeated inference costly, particularly in high dimensions. We introduce KANs with Tractable Operators for Uncertainty and Constraints (TOUCKANs), whose finite-degree polynomial outer functions yield a decomposable sum--product representation. Under factorizing input measures, expectations and higher moments then reduce algebraically to deterministic recursions over one-dimensional leaf integrals. Independent and shared inner-block variants form a parameter-efficiency hierarchy, and a universal-approximation proof for its most restricted member extends to the complete class. The same deterministic operators allow conserved integrals and normalization to be imposed throughout training. Across uniform and Gaussian benchmarks through 50 dimensions, deterministic mean and variance errors remained below the median fixed-budget Monte Carlo errors in every case. TOUCKANs also conserved Cahn--Hilliard mass to machine precision and imposed normalization and orthogonality through deterministic moments, enabling joint computation of the lowest four Schr\"odinger eigenpairs in two, three, and five dimensions. TOUCKANs therefore connect KAN approximation with tractable probabilistic circuits, making statistical operators and integral constraints directly available within an expressive neural surrogate.
papers.title_ja: Kolmogorov-Arnoldネットワークを用いた計算可能な推論
papers.summary_ja: 計算科学における機械学習サロゲートモデルにおいて、期待値や分散などの統計量や保存積分をモンテカルロ法に頼らず効率的に計算する手法「TOUCKANs」を提案する。Kolmogorov-Arnoldネットワーク（KAN）の外部関数を有限次数の多項式とすることで、確率回路と同様の分解可能な和積表現を実現し、高次元でも決定論的な再帰計算で統計量を導出可能にする。さらに、訓練過程で保存量や正規化を厳密に強制する制約付き学習も可能であり、50次元までのベンチマークで固定予算のモンテカルロ法を上回る精度を達成した。Cahn-Hilliard方程式の質量保存やシュレーディンガー方程式の固有値計算など、物理法則を内包した高精度なサロゲートモデル構築に有効である。
papers.relevance_reason: サロゲートモデルと物理情報、効率化の関心に高度に一致

papers.title: A PDE-theory-guided neural operator and the long-time relaxation of the two-dimensional anisotropic Boussinesq system
papers.summary: We design a neural operator for the two-dimensional Boussinesq system with anisotropic dissipation on the periodic box, guided by a rigorous analysis of its long-time behavior. The operator maps a small perturbation of hydrostatic equilibrium, of amplitude $\varepsilon$, to the vorticity at a late time. We prove that the flow relaxes to a stratified shear flow, with the horizontally averaged vorticity staying within $O(\varepsilon^2)$ of its initial value $\bar\omega_0$ and the oscillation about it of order $\varepsilon$. Accordingly, the network outputs $\bar\omega_0$ plus these two parts, each scaled to its size, which grows as $\varepsilon^2$ and $\varepsilon$, respectively. Without this guidance the training either does not converge or misses the $\varepsilon^2$ growth. With it, one network reproduces, sample by sample on $2\times10^3$ test runs over a factor of $23$ in amplitude, the quantity bounded by the theorem to a median error of $2.2$ percent. Being fast and differentiable with respect to the initial data, the network is also used to search the space of initial data, and with every candidate checked by the solver the search finds initial data for which this quantity is $4.4$ times the largest value among the test runs, raising the lower bound for the constant of the theorem by that factor.
papers.title_ja: PDE理論に導かれたニューラルオペレータと2次元異方性ブシネスク系の長時間緩和
papers.summary_ja: 厳密なPDE解析に基づき、2次元異方性ブシネスク系の長時間挙動を予測するニューラルオペレータを設計した。水静力平衡からの微小摂動を渦度に変換する際、理論的な成長率（ε^2とε）をネットワーク構造に組み込むことで、学習の収束性と精度を大幅に向上させた。この高速かつ微分可能なモデルを用いて初期条件空間を探索し、理論定数の下限を既存のテストケースより4.4倍大きくする新たな初期データを発見した。
papers.relevance_reason: PDE理論とニューラルオペレータの融合、サロゲートモデルによる最適化探索という関心領域と完全に一致。

papers.title: To Keep or Not to Keep: Learning KV Cache Retention in Disaggregated LLM Serving Systems
papers.summary: Disaggregated \textsc{LLM} serving separates prefill and decode across node pools, placing a network fabric between \textsc{KV}-cache computation and consumption. This breaks a key assumption of classical cache policies: a miss no longer incurs only local recomputation, but also network transfer to the decode node. Likewise, admitting a block to the global cache requires an additional transfer, so poor retention decisions waste both memory and bandwidth. We present \textbf{KVLearn}, a learning-based framework for cost-aware \textsc{KV}-cache retention in disaggregated serving. KVLearn includes: (i) a lightweight Prefix Reuse Predictor (\textsc{PRP}) that estimates reuse probability from structural and temporal prefix features without modifying model weights; (ii) a Cost-Aware Retention Score (\textsc{CARS}) that converts reuse probability into keep/admit decisions using recomputation, transfer, and storage costs; and (iii) an Adaptive Threshold Controller (\textsc{ATC}) that adjusts admission thresholds online from observed hit rates and memory pressure. We integrate KVLearn into a globally disaggregated serving topology and evaluate it on text and multimodal workloads, including large image/video-derived \textsc{KV} blocks with heterogeneous reuse patterns. KVLearn reduces end-to-end time-to-first-token by up to 56% versus No-Cache, 38% versus LRU-Pool, and 33% versus Mooncake-style baselines, while cutting inter-node \textsc{KV} transfer volume by up to 53% versus LRU-Pool. On MM-Session, throughput remains within ${\sim}5%$ of oracle. Code is available at https://github.com/FastLM/KVLearn.
papers.title_ja: 分離型LLMサービングシステムにおけるKVキャッシュ保持の学習
papers.summary_ja: 分離型LLMサービング環境において、プリフィルとデコードを異なるノードで処理する際のKVキャッシュ管理問題を解決するフレームワーク「KVLearn」を提案する。モデル重みの変更なしで再利用確率を予測する軽量な予測器と、計算・転送・ストレージコストを考慮した保持スコア、およびオンラインで閾値を調整するコントローラから構成される。テキストおよびマルチモーダルワークロードでの評価により、既存のLRUやMooncake方式と比較して、初回トークンまでの時間（TTFT）を最大56%短縮し、ノード間KV転送量を最大53%削減できることを示した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLM推論高速化とサービング効率化の核心技術であり、ユーザーの関心と高度に一致する。

papers.title: ReAPO: Retry-Aware Policy Optimization for Efficient Exploration in LLM Reasoning
papers.summary: RLVR improves language-model reasoning, but commonly relies on independent stochastic rollouts for exploration, which can repeatedly sample similar failed strategies. Prior work has seen success with approaches that guide exploration by introducing dependence into the sampling process by including incorrect solutions in the context for subsequent attempts. Still, these methods introduce the additional question of how to assign credit to each attempt. We propose to view the credit assignment through the lens of Stochastic Shortest Paths, a framework in classical reinforcement learning that seeks to minimize the expected cumulative cost to reach a terminal state (in our case, a verified successful response). We show that, under suitable simplifying assumptions, this perspective naturally leads to a simple modification to GRPO, which we call Retry-Aware Policy Optimization (ReAPO). ReAPO allocates additional generation to failed trajectories, allowing successful retries to be reinforced without rewarding preceding failures, and assigns credit in a theoretically principled way to each attempt. Across Qwen3 and OLMo-2 models from 0.6B to 4B and eight mathematical and scientific reasoning benchmarks, ReAPO improves first-attempt performance over GRPO as well as natural recent baseline algorithms, while additional ablations demonstrate the utility of both serial sampling and ReAPO's credit assignment. On Qwen3-0.6B, ReAPO also outperforms GRPO with twice the group size or twice the training steps, reaching their peak accuracy with 39% and 31% fewer generated tokens, respectively. Taken together, our results suggest that ReAPO is a simple yet effective approach for improving LM reasoning performance through improved exploration and retry-aware credit assignment.
papers.title_ja: ReAPO: LLM推論における効率的な探索のためのリトライ認識型ポリシー最適化
papers.summary_ja: LLMの推論能力向上において、失敗した試行を再利用する探索手法のクレジットアサインメント問題を、確率的最短経路問題として定式化し解決する。提案手法ReAPOは、失敗した軌道に追加生成を割り当て、成功したリトライのみを強化しつつ、理論的に原則に基づいたクレジット配分を行う。Qwen3やOLMo-2などのモデルで、既存手法より少ないトークン数で同等以上の性能を達成し、推論効率の大幅な向上を実証した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLM推論の効率化と強化学習手法の融合であり、ユーザーの関心と高度に一致する。

papers.title: Building a Nested LADDER for LLM Unstructured Post-Training Pruning
papers.summary: Non-uniform allocation can improve post-training pruning of large language models, yet quality can still degrade sharply at high sparsity. To control degradation as sparsity increases, we introduce LADDER (Layer-Wise Allocation via Damage-Driven Evaluation and Refinement), which allocates sparsity incrementally. At each step, it evaluates pruning an additional fraction of weights from each eligible layer and commits the layer update that causes the least end-to-end degradation per removed parameter. This process produces non-uniform sparsity profiles and exactly nested masks across multiple budgets. We evaluate LADDER on five OPT, Llama, and Qwen models across 10-90% sparsity, using SparseGPT as its candidate-generation backend and comparing against uniform and adaptive allocation baselines. Results reveal a clear operating-regime trade-off: LADDER is comparable or slightly weaker at benign sparsity but becomes substantially more robust from 70% onward. This high-sparsity advantage largely persists after posterior distillation across four of five models and translates into improved retention of aggregate zero-shot accuracy.
papers.title_ja: LLMの非構造化ポストトレーニング剪定のためのネスト型LADDERの構築
papers.summary_ja: 大規模言語モデル（LLM）のポストトレーニング剪定において、高スパース度時の品質劣化を抑制する手法LADDERを提案する。各層の重みを段階的に除去し、エンドツーエンドの性能低下が最小となる層を更新することで、非一様なスパースプロファイルと正確にネストされたマスクを生成する。OPT、Llama、Qwenモデルで10〜90%のスパース度を評価し、70%以上の高スパース領域で既存手法より大幅に頑健であることを示した。後処理の蒸留後もこの高スパース時の優位性は維持され、ゼロショット精度の保持に寄与する。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMの効率化・推論高速化・量子化（剪定）に直結する手法

papers.title: Neural Vector Field Transformations: Learning the Flow of Autonomous Systems by Conjugation to Explicitly Integrable Reference Flows
papers.summary: We represent the flow map of an autonomous ODE $\dot x=f(x)$ as a conjugate $\Phi_t=F_\theta^{-1}\circ\Psi_t\circ F_\theta$ of an explicitly integrable reference flow $\Psi_t$ by an invertible neural network $F_\theta$, the neural vector field transformation. The representation is an exact flow for every parameter value and inherits the phase portrait of the reference. A $C^1$ conjugacy preserves the eigenvalues of equilibria, the periods and Floquet multipliers of periodic orbits and the frequency-amplitude relation of centers, so these invariants must be learnable parameters of $\Psi$. We give parametrized reference flows with explicit integral curves, show that an action-angle reference is Hamiltonian only if its learnable frequency map is a gradient, and show that an orientation-preserving $F_\theta$ cannot reverse the rotation sense of the reference, so it must be fixed before training. The main contribution is a training recipe: a push-forward equation residual made relative to $|f|$ and sampled log-uniformly in $|x|$ around an equilibrium, with the anchors $F_\theta(0)=0$, $DF_\theta(0)=I$; a symplectic transformation with the gradient-form frequency map; and invariants initialized from the field or data. With it the full spectrum of a three- and a six-dimensional nonlinear sink is recovered (eigenvalue deviation $8.3\times10^{-3}$ and relative error 2.3%, three seeds each), and the action-angle variables of a four-dimensional integrable Hamiltonian system with frequency maps and actions correct to a median of 0.09% and 0.22%, and an exactly symplectic flow. On a dispersive system a time-input network is eight times more accurate inside its horizon, and the data-only identification of the Van der Pol oscillator yields a conjugacy on the data region with the Floquet exponent 17% off; an oracle run with the true invariants frozen attributes this to the expressivity of $F_\theta$.
papers.title_ja: ニューラルベクトル場変換：明示的に積分可能な参照フローへの共役による自律系のフローの学習
papers.summary_ja: 自律常微分方程式のフローを、可逆ニューラルネットワークによる共役変換を用いて明示的に積分可能な参照フローで表現する手法を提案する。この表現はパラメータ値に関わらず厳密なフローであり、平衡点の固有値や周期軌道のフロケ乗数などの不変量を保持する。訓練レシピとして、対数一様サンプリングを用いたプッシュフォワード方程式残差やシンプレクティック変換などを示し、非線形シンクやハミルトン系において高精度なスペクトルや作用・角度変数を再現することを検証した。
papers.relevance_reason: 物理情報ニューラルネットとサロゲートモデルの高度な応用であり、軌道力学の基礎となるODE解法と密接に関連する。

papers.title: Resuming Vision-Language Inference across Onboard Interruptions
papers.summary: Executing vision-language models (VLMs) aboard low-Earth orbit satellites enables flexible processing of observation data without first downlinking it to the ground. On commercial off-the-shelf payloads, however, a request may span multiple execution windows: power and thermal constraints, fault-triggered reboots, and competing payload demands can interrupt inference before it completes. Each shutdown discards volatile activations and KV caches, forcing an unprotected request to repeat work after restart. We present OrbitWeaver, a framework that preserves VLM inference progress across onboard interruptions through coordinated checkpointing and recovery. Its phase-aware checkpointing selects recovery boundaries according to the state lifetimes and computational characteristics of vision encoding, language-model prefill, and decoding, balancing storage traffic against recomputation. Its dependency-aware dynamic recovery schedules restoration from partially completed states across the layer and token-chunk dimensions. By overlapping checkpoint and weight reads with recomputation, it reduces restart latency; the recovery planner computes an optimal execution order under its scheduling model within 100 ms. Experiments on satellite payload hardware using on-orbit telemetry traces show up to a 4.07-fold end-to-end speedup and a 3.56-fold reduction in SSD write volume over the evaluated baselines. A 72-hour deployment on two low-Earth orbit satellites demonstrates that OrbitWeaver retains inference progress and resumes execution across repeated bus-enforced shutdowns.
papers.title_ja: 機上での中断をまたいでビジョン・言語推論を再開する
papers.summary_ja: 低軌道衛星上でビジョン・言語モデル（VLM）の推論を、電力制約や再起動などの中断をまたいで継続するフレームワーク「OrbitWeaver」を提案する。フェーズ認識型チェックポイントと依存関係考慮型動的復旧により、ストレージ負荷と再計算のバランスを最適化し、再起動時の遅延を低減する。衛星ペイロードハードウェアでの実験により、エンドツーエンドの最大4.07倍の高速化とSSD書き込み量の3.56倍の削減を実証した。

papers.title: When Thoughts Become Memory: Unifying In-Context Learning and Fine-Tuning
papers.summary: We are the first to give a certified rule for whether unseen data belong in a pretrained model's context or its weights, built on an exact law for their information value. That value, the code length saved on held-out queries, equals in expectation the bits stored about the query, plus a prior repair, minus a decoding loss, for any model, architecture, dataset and task. The law's ceilings certify the choice from one measurement, and an anytime-valid test makes it from held-out queries, with error controlled whenever it stops. Every certificate the ceilings issue on a trained transformer, TabPFN, an occupancy network and a stereo network is correct. The test picks TabPFN over XGBoost and a trained surrogate over an in-context learner on airfoil pressure, calls the better of GPT-2's cache and fine-tune in 61,948 of 64,000 query streams over 32 comparisons, and errs in at most 3.3% of null streams. The law also diagnoses when learning in context helps and when it does not. Deleting part of a context is held-out validation of that part in any model, and adding parts one at a time traces the learning curve in context: one patch that sees a shape feature cuts an occupancy network's code length there a hundredfold, while eight that miss it nearly double it, and one camera that sees the surface beats four in a stereo network. Ranked by this label-free valuation, a kriging learner's three best support cars beat four drawn at random, and on a yes-or-no claim the valuation recovers a published evidence adjudicator, with AUROC 0.91.
papers.title_ja: 思考が記憶になる時：インコンテキスト学習とファインチューニングの統一
papers.summary_ja: 未見データが事前学習モデルのコンテキスト（メモリ）に属するか重み（ファインチューニング）に属するかを判定する、保証付きルールを初めて提案した。情報理論に基づき、保持クエリにおけるコード長削減量（情報価値）を厳密に定式化し、その上限値から一度の測定で選択を認証する。TabPFNやGPT-2など多様なモデルで検証し、コンテキスト学習とファインチューニングのどちらが優れるかを高精度で判定できることを示した。さらに、コンテキスト内の要素の重要性評価や、学習曲線の追跡を通じて、インコンテキスト学習が有効な条件を診断する手法も提示している。
