papers.title: One Act, Many Masks: Effect-Marginal Policy Optimization for Long-Horizon Agents
papers.summary: Recent advances in multi-turn reinforcement learning (RL) have substantially improved the performance of LLM agents on complex, long-horizon interactive tasks. However, despite progress in fine-grained credit assignment, policy optimization still applies these learning signals through response-specific probability ratios. Different textual responses can induce the same executable effect, yet credit differences arising from subsequent outcomes remain tied to their individual textual realizations. We identify this mismatch as credit-update misalignment. Our analysis reveals that credit-text pairing directly shapes policy-update directions, even when the policy context and executable effect are held fixed. Motivated by this finding, we propose Effect-Marginal Policy Optimization (EMPO), which aligns policy optimization with execution-level equivalence through an effect-level surrogate that couples updates across alternative textual realizations. EMPO preserves the original credit signals, integrates with both trajectory-level and step-level credit estimators, and requires no additional critics or rollouts. Experiments on ALFWorld, WebShop, and Sokoban show that EMPO outperforms strong baselines in both task performance and learning efficiency.
papers.title_ja: 1つの行為、多くの仮面：長期エージェントのための効果辺際方策最適化
papers.summary_ja: LLMエージェントの強化学習において、異なるテキスト応答が同じ実行効果を生み出す場合でも、信用割当がテキストごとに紐付けられる「クレジット更新の不一致」問題を指摘する。この問題を解決するため、実行レベルの等価性を考慮したサロゲートモデルを用いるEMPO（Effect-Marginal Policy Optimization）を提案する。EMPOは追加のクリティクやロールアウトを必要とせず、既存のクレジット推定器と統合可能である。ALFWorldなどのベンチマークで、タスク性能と学習効率の両面で既存手法を上回ることを示した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMエージェント設計と強化学習手法の改善に直結する

papers.title: ArcFlow: Training Flow Policies for Multiple Solver Budgets
papers.summary: Flow-matching policies adjust inference cost through the number of solver steps, but reinforcement learning at a single fixed solver budget can hide degradation at cheaper deployment budgets and even erase useful one-step behavior present in a pretrained policy. We introduce Action-Ratio-Clip Flow (ArcFlow), a deployment-aware algorithm for training one flow policy across a specified range of solver budgets. ArcFlow combines action-aligned supervision, budget exposure, and worst-budget checkpoint selection. For reconstruction objectives, its bridge aggregates temporal probes into one surrogate ratio and one PPO-style clip per action, with a boundary residual exactly equal to deployed one-step reconstruction error. Cycling exposes the shared field to the deployment range, and selection optimizes its performance floor. For native velocity objectives, multi-budget endpoint supervision applies the same principle without replacing the native update. Both realizations preserve the architecture and deployment-time cost. Across DM Control, manipulation, and locomotion, ArcFlow attains the highest mean one-step return among five flow-policy baselines on 25 of 30 tasks under each method's reported training settings. Component studies identify complementary improvements from boundary supervision, the fixed-grid bridge, budget exposure, and deployment selection. These results establish deployment-budget-aware training as an effective route to strong low-step control with one policy serving multiple inference costs.
papers.title_ja: ArcFlow: 複数ソルバ予算に対応するフローポリシーの学習
papers.summary_ja: フローマッチングベースの強化学習において、推論コスト（ソルバステップ数）を固定した学習が低コスト運用時の性能劣化を隠蔽する問題を解決するアルゴリズム「ArcFlow」を提案する。本手法は、指定されたソルバ予算の範囲内で単一のポリシーを学習し、最悪ケースのチェックポイント選択やアクション整合性の監視を通じて、低ステップ数での推論性能を最適化する。DM Controlやマニピュレーションなどのタスクにおいて、既存の5つのフローポリシーベースラインと比較し、25/30のタスクで1ステップ時の平均リターンが最高であることを示した。これにより、一つのモデルで多様な推論コストに対応しつつ、低コスト環境での制御性能を維持できることを実証している。
papers.relevance_reason: 強化学習と推論効率化（ステップ数削減）の両方に深く関連する手法。

papers.title: Local and Sparse Kernel Operator Learning for Incompressible Flows: An Operator Lagrange Formulation
papers.summary: We present a local and sparse kernel method for learning the solution operators of incompressible flows. It builds on our earlier property-preserving kernel method, whose global output reconstruction and dense operator regression scale poorly. Our method replaces the global output reconstruction by local divergence-free interpolants with divergence-free polynomials of any degree, solved in parallel on the GPU. These interpolants are divergence free, periodic on periodic domains, and, with a multiscale kernel, approach Kolmogorov statistics under refinement. A compactly supported kernel, positive semidefinite in any input dimension, makes the operator regression sparse. Its support radius, and hence the sparsity, is fitted to data, and optional affine polynomials in the input capture global trends. Operator Lagrange weights join the two. They cost one sparse solve per new input and act on the training fields before the output reconstruction, so their local coefficients are never formed. We show that, unlike direct evaluation, Lagrange evaluation does not amplify solve errors by the cancellation among spatial coefficients. On ten fluid benchmarks, validation selects sparse matrices nearly everywhere, with densities that mostly decrease as the training set grows, and affine augmentation lowers the error by more than an order of magnitude for forced isotropic turbulence. These sparse models are at least as accurate as our earlier dense method and more accurate than neural operators. Lagrange evaluation is as accurate as direct evaluation with local output reconstructions, and up to nearly three orders of magnitude more accurate with global ones. We also present GPU timings and storage.
papers.title_ja: 非圧縮流のための局所・スパースカーネル演算子学習：演算子ラグランジュ定式化
papers.summary_ja: 非圧縮流の解演算子を学習する局所かつスパースなカーネル手法を提案する。従来の密な演算子回帰を、GPUで並列計算可能な局所発散フリー補間と、コンパクトサポートカーネルによるスパース化で置き換えた。演算子ラグランジュ重みを用いることで、新しい入力に対する計算コストを1回のスパース解法に抑え、誤差増幅を抑制する。10種の流体ベンチマークにおいて、ニューラルオペレータより高精度であり、訓練データ増加に伴いスパース性が向上する特性を示した。
papers.relevance_reason: ニューラルオペレータの代替手法として、流体シミュレーションの高速化と精度向上に直結する。

papers.title: SU(2)-Equivariant Spinor Message Passing for Molecular Magnetism
papers.summary: Predicting molecular magnetism often requires electronic-structure calculations with spin-orbit coupling (SOC), which are costly to repeat across many molecules. The underlying electronic states can transform as spinors, yet equivariant surrogates typically use only integer-rank features. Inspired by the spinor nature of these electronic states, we develop eSpinor, an SU(2)-equivariant graph neural network that propagates spinor features. We initialize spinor features from eigenvectors of an approximate SOC Hamiltonian and use gauge-covariant message passing with a gauge-invariant readout to make predictions independent of the arbitrary eigenbasis choice. On cobalt single-molecule magnet candidates, eSpinor improves zero-field-splitting predictions relative to NequIP, including for unseen ligands. For a dysprosium magnetic resonance imaging probe, eSpinor improves real electron-spin correlations over a Hamiltonian-informed baseline despite similar static crystal-field errors and fewer parameters, while accurately predicting low-field nuclear relaxation in water and after transfer to methanol without retraining. Overall, these results demonstrate that SU(2)-equivariant spinor message passing is a useful inductive bias for molecular magnetism. We also find that similar static tensor errors can yield different dynamical errors, motivating model selection based on accuracy for the intended physical observables.
papers.title_ja: 分子磁性のためのSU(2)等変スピンォーメッセージパッシング
papers.summary_ja: スピン軌道結合を含む電子構造計算の計算コストを削減するため、スピンォー特徴量を用いたSU(2)等変グラフニューラルネットワーク「eSpinor」を提案する。近似スピン軌道結合ハミルトニアンから初期化し、ゲージ共変メッセージパッシングとゲージ不変リードアウトにより、固有基底の選択に依存しない予測を実現した。コバルト単一分子磁石候補においてNequIPを上回るゼロ場分裂の予測精度を示し、ジスプロシウムMRIプローブではパラメータ数を減らしつつ電子スピン相関を改善した。静的なテンソル誤差が類似であっても動的誤差が異なることから、目的とする物理量に基づくモデル選択の重要性も示唆している。
papers.relevance_reason: 高コストな物理計算のサロゲートモデル化と等変GNNという手法が関心に合致

papers.title: Metamodel-Guided LLM Decoding for Consistent DSL Generation
papers.summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to generate software engineering artifacts written in domain-specific languages (DSLs). Correct DSL instances usually must comply with not only the concrete syntax but also the abstract syntax defined by a metamodel augmented with semantic well-formedness constraints. Existing constrained decoding approaches typically guarantee compliance only with concrete syntax or with a limited set of semantic constraints expressed over the generated text, making metamodel-level constraint consistency difficult to enforce during generation. We present MeMoDecode: a decoding framework that enforces a DSL's concrete syntax, abstract syntax, and well-formedness constraints jointly. Specifically, whenever the LLM generates a complete metamodel concept, MeMoDecode incrementally maps the current output to a partial model and verifies whether it can still be completed into a consistent instance. We combine MeMoDecode with a simple retry mechanism that resumes decoding from the most recent completable snapshot whenever an inconsistency is detected. Under a sound backend verifier, MeMoDecode never performs worse than grammar-constrained decoding on alignment metrics satisfying natural assumptions. Across four DSLs and six open-weight LLMs ranging from 0.6B to 70B parameters, MeMoDecode achieves the highest consistency, improving consistency by 23% on average over unconstrained decoding and by 8% on average over grammar-constrained decoding. It also improves benchmark performance while incurring only modest runtime overhead. These results show that metamodel-guided decoding is an effective approach for enforcing DSL consistency during decoding across diverse DSLs and LLM scales.
papers.title_ja: メタモデル主導による一貫性のあるDSL生成のためのLLMデコーディング
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、ドメイン固有言語（DSL）生成において、具体構文だけでなくメタモデル定義された抽象構文や意味的制約も同時に満たすデコーディングフレームワーク「MeMoDecode」を提案する。LLMがメタモデルの概念を生成するたびに部分モデルとして検証し、不整合を検出したら直近の整合状態からデコーディングを再開するリトライ機構を備えている。4つのDSLと6つのLLM（0.6B〜70B）での実験により、文法制約付きデコーディング比で平均8%、無制約比で23%の一貫性向上と、わずかな実行時間オーバーヘッドのみでベンチマーク性能の向上を実証した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLM推論時の制約付きデコーディングとハルシネーション対策に直結する手法

papers.title: LaVGuard: Selective Decoding for Contextual Value Drift
papers.summary: A content-safe response can still promote priorities that conflict with its task: an assistant may demand compliance when asked to preserve autonomy. We study contextual value drift as a task-relative decoding problem with an explicit allowance for change. LaVGuard separates an authorized ten-dimensional profile from a frozen estimate of the values expressed in the visible prefix. A profile-relative density gate selects when to evaluate candidate continuations; their signed progress determines a logit tilt constrained by both changed-position and cumulative-KL budgets. We establish local surrogate improvement, pathwise budget feasibility, and a bound on response-distribution change. Profile conditioning raises boundary TPR at 5% FPR from .58 to .72. At the same .12 mean intervention ratio, the selection study reports risk-safety scores of .88 for LaVGuard and .72 for position-matched edits. The resulting interface makes task priorities actionable while keeping the extent of intervention explicit and bounded.
papers.title_ja: LaVGuard: コンテキストにおける価値観のドリフトに対する選択的デコーディング
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、LLMの応答がタスクと矛盾する価値観を促進する「コンテキスト的価値ドリフト」問題に対処する手法を提案する。認可された10次元のプロファイルと可視プレフィックスの価値観推定値を分離し、プロファイル相対密度ゲートを用いて候補継続の評価タイミングを選択する。符号付き進捗に基づき、変更位置と累積KL予算で制約されたロジット傾斜を適用することで、介入範囲を明示かつ有界に保つ。実験では、5%の偽陽性率における境界TPRが0.58から0.72へ向上し、リスク安全性スコアも既存手法を上回ることが示された。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMの推論・デコーディング制御と安全性評価に直結する手法

papers.title: SimHack: Predicting the onset of detectable reward hacking before RL training
papers.summary: When training LLMs to code with reinforcement learning, reward hacking is often detectable but difficult to prevent, since (a) environment hardening is increasingly difficult as training environments grow more complex; and (b) training-time interventions incentivize models to obfuscate hacking behavior to bypass detection. We instead study whether we can predict when detectable reward hacking becomes dominant before executing an RL run, enabling us to select lower-risk recipes in advance. We find that the initial hacking rate alone does not determine onset, which varies substantially across training recipes and repeated runs. We thus formulate this problem as predicting the distribution of the reward hacking onset step under a target training recipe. We introduce SimHack, a simulator that learns reward hacking training dynamics from a handful of smaller-scale reference RL runs and generates counterfactual simulation runs of unseen target recipes without costly retraining. Across unseen target recipes, SimHack predicts the median onset to a relative error of 11.3% and achieves across-recipe rank correlation of 0.85, while generalizing to differences in model scale, curriculum, number of rollouts, and learning rate between reference and target recipes. As an application, we show that SimHack can guide training decisions by screening candidate RL curricula, discovering curricula over the same set of scenarios that train for 96.6% longer without hacking.
papers.title_ja: SimHack: 強化学習訓練前の検出可能な報酬ハッキングの発生予測
papers.summary_ja: LLMの強化学習における報酬ハッキング（ごまかし）の発生タイミングを、高コストな再訓練なしに予測するシミュレータ「SimHack」を提案する。少数のスモールスケールの参照実行データから学習し、未見の訓練レシピに対するハッキング発生ステップの分布を生成する。この手法により、ハッキングリスクが低い訓練レシピを事前にスクリーニングでき、ハッキングなしで訓練時間を96.6%延長できるカリキュラムの発見が可能になった。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMのRL訓練効率化とリスク低減に直結する手法

papers.title: STAR-XPC: Set Transformer for Estimating X-ray Transmission in Polymer Composites
papers.summary: Evaluating the energy transmission ratio of an X-ray beam through a polymer composite is a challenging task in radiation shielding studies. The reference solution with Monte Carlo transport simulation is highly accurate but computationally expensive: each of our reference simulations is capped at $4\times10^9$ photon histories and a 20,000 s (over 5 hours) time limit, while closed-form analytical methods fail to represent such complex scenarios. We present an artificial neural network model that maps the unordered multi-set of molecular constituents, their mass fractions, and four bulk physical descriptors directly to the transmission ratio $I(t)/I_0$ in 1-3 milliseconds. The model is a Set Transformer, which makes it permutation invariant by construction and accepts mixtures of different sizes up to 11 constituents within a fixed-size padded set. Each constituent is embedded with a chemistry-pretrained transformer language model, ChemBERTa. In our proposed method, training data are produced by an automated PENELOPE/penEasy pipeline using the radiation source at 30, 80, 100, and 120 kV tube voltages over polyethylene-based shielding composite slabs of thicknesses spanning 0.15-2.5 mm. After preprocessing, the dataset contains $n = 4697$ simulated configurations on which a leakage-free, jointly stratified 10-fold cross-validation is performed, attaining mean squared error MSE = $(1.12 \pm 0.56)\times10^{-4}$, normalized-MSE percentage NMSE% = 0.0294% $\pm$ 0.0147%, and $R^2 = 0.9988$. The corresponding per-sample percentage errors give an alpha-trimmed ($\alpha = 0.10$) absolute percentage error (APE) of 1.66% and a median APE of 1.15%. Our model's inference is several orders of magnitude faster than the underlying Monte Carlo simulation (sub-millisecond per query vs. several hours for the reference run) with effective accuracy in predicting $I(t)/I_0$.
papers.title_ja: STAR-XPC: 高分子複合材におけるX線透過率推定のためのセットトランスフォーマー
papers.summary_ja: 本研究では、放射線遮蔽材のX線透過率をモンテカルロシミュレーションよりも高速に推定する人工ニューラルネットワークモデルを提案する。モデルはSet Transformerを用いて分子構成要素の順序不変性を保証し、ChemBERTaによる化学的エンベディングを活用する。PENELOPEシミュレーションで生成したデータセットを用いた検証では、数時間かかる参照計算に対し1〜3ミリ秒での推論を実現しつつ、R^2=0.9988という高精度を達成した。
papers.relevance_reason: サロゲートモデルによる物理シミュレーション高速化の典型例であり、手法が関心に合致

papers.title: Big Claims, Small Margins: Do Reported GraphLLM Gains Survive Simple Baselines?
papers.summary: LLM-based methods for node classification on text-attributed graphs (TAGs) routinely report state-of-the-art accuracy. We ask how these results compare with inexpensive baselines run on the same splits. On the splits of three recent studies, we tune four baseline representatives with validation-only selection and compare them with the highest mean that each paper reports for an LLM-based method in the matched setting. Correct & Smooth on TF-IDF features trails this reference by a median of 2.3 percentage points, and an MLP on frozen e5-large-v2 embeddings by 2.8 points. Correct & Smooth is within 3 points of the reference or better on 15 of 24 tasks, but the reference is significantly higher on 12 of 22 testable tasks, so several reported gains remain substantial. Reading released code next to the papers, we also document evaluation risks: selection of hyperparameters or checkpoints on the test set, labels of test-pool nodes used in training, baseline numbers reused without disclosure, and a text-label misalignment in a released Cora loader. Reports of the same method on the same split also differ by up to 12.5 points across papers whose configurations are not documented to match.
papers.title_ja: 大きな主張、小さな差：報告されたGraphLLMの性能向上は単純なベースラインに耐えられるか？
papers.summary_ja: テキスト属性グラフ（TAG）におけるノード分類タスクで、LLMベース手法が報告するSOTA性能が単純なベースラインと比較して本当に優れているかを検証した。TF-IDF特徴量を用いたCorrect & Smoothや、凍結したe5-large-v2埋め込みを用いたMLPなど、低コストなベースラインを調整し、最近の3研究の分割データで比較した結果、LLM手法の優位性は中央値で2.3〜2.8ポイント程度と限定的であることが判明した。さらに、テストセットでのハイパーパラメータ選択やラベル漏洩など、既存研究における評価リスクや再現性の問題も指摘している。
papers.relevance_reason: LLM効率化と評価手法・ベンチマークの信頼性に関わる重要な検証

papers.title: Automating ML for Science: Can Frontier Agents Climb Scientific Hills in the Wild?
papers.summary: Frontier coding agents are increasingly framed as end-to-end automated researchers, and ML for science offers a demanding test of that promise: improving a scientific model often requires domain insight beyond routine ML engineering. We introduce Agent4Sci, a long-horizon testbed for measuring how far today's agents can improve the published best models on scientific ML benchmarks, spanning 20 benchmarks across 11 domains. Rather than ranking agents on a leaderboard, Agent4Sci asks what kinds of progress agents can make on these tasks under in-the-wild conditions, and where they fall short. Empirically, today's frontier agents advance the published best on every benchmark, with Claude Opus reaching 10.4% mean relative improvement and no run flagged for academic misconduct. These gains, however, come almost entirely from a bag of ML-engineering tricks rather than research-level insight. Trajectory analysis surfaces three recurring limitations in this setting: novelty miscalibration, resource under-utilization, and rapid collapse into local engineering sweeps. Lightweight plug-in skills for research ideation, experiment management, and scheduled checklists raise Claude Opus from 10.4% to 20.1% and Codex from 4.4% to 8.1%, while yielding more diverse, domain-relevant interventions. Agent4Sci gives the community a way to track and push frontier agents from ML engineering toward domain insight on real-world ML-for-science problems. Code and data are available on GitHub (https://github.com/maszhongming/agent4sci) and Hugging Face (https://huggingface.co/datasets/MingZhong/agent4sci).
papers.title_ja: 科学のための機械学習の自動化：フロンティアエージェントは実環境で科学的な課題を克服できるか？
papers.summary_ja: 科学分野における機械学習モデルの改善能力を評価する長期テストベッド「Agent4Sci」を提案する。20のベンチマークでフロンティアエージェントの実力を検証し、既存の最良モデルを上回る結果を示したが、その改善は主にMLエンジニアリング的な手法によるものであることが判明した。新規性の誤評価やリソースの未活用といった限界を特定し、研究アイデア生成や実験管理などのプラグインスキルを追加することで、Claude Opusの相対改善率を10.4%から20.1%まで向上させた。本手法は、エージェントを単なるコード生成から、ドメインインサイトを持つ研究者レベルの自動化へと進化させるための基盤を提供する。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMエージェント設計と科学MLの自動化が関心と一致

papers.title: SkillEval: Learning Interpretable Ability Profiles of LLMs via Cognitive Diagnosis Models
papers.summary: Current evaluation of LLMs on benchmarks typically aggregates performance over individual examples into a single scalar score. This approach is overly coarse and ignores the diverse scope of skills covered by benchmark datasets. To address this limitation and better exploit benchmark data, we propose SkillEval, a new evaluation framework that performs cross-model, skill-level analysis. The framework integrates advances from two areas: (1) it leverages the meta-cognitive capabilities of LLMs to automatically discover interpretable skills from questions, and (2) it applies cognitive diagnosis models (CDMs) from psychometrics to estimate per-skill abilities of LLMs. We conduct experiments on 3,811 LLMs evaluated on 9,523 items across five benchmarks spanning diverse domains (MATH, BBH, GPQA, MuSR, IFEval). Compared to the traditional average-based evaluation paradigm, SkillEval produces reliable, more calibrated and informative yet concise model profiles that more accurately predict model behavior on unseen items. We also demonstrate the utility of SkillEval in two downstream tasks: (1) LLM routing, which dynamically assigns each query to a capable but efficient model, reducing inference cost by over 60% while achieving improved performance, and (2) Computerized Adaptive Testing (CAT), where an unseen model can be efficiently evaluated using a trained CDM. Furthermore, we show that these skill profiles provide useful insights, for example, how benchmarks share skills and how instruction-tuned models differ from their base models.
papers.title_ja: SkillEval: 認知診断モデルを用いたLLMの解釈可能な能力プロファイルの学習
papers.summary_ja: 従来の単一スコア評価の限界を克服するため、認知診断モデル（CDM）とLLMのメタ認知機能を統合した新しい評価フレームワーク「SkillEval」を提案する。この手法により、ベンチマークから解釈可能なスキルを自動発見し、モデルごとのスキル別能力を推定できる。実験では、従来の平均ベース評価よりも正確で情報量豊富なモデルプロファイルが得られ、未見項目での挙動予測精度が向上したことを示した。さらに、LLMルーティングによる推論コストの大幅削減や、コンピュータ適応テスト（CAT）への応用など、実務的な利点を実証している。
papers.relevance_reason: LLM評価手法と推論コスト削減（ルーティング）に直結する

papers.title: Measure First, Then Allocate: Calibrated Rollout Budgets for MCP Agents in Reinforcement Learning
papers.summary: Training tool-using language models requires costly interaction, yet identical rewards within a rollout group provide no group-relative learning signal. We use reward disagreement to guide harness evaluation and the allocation of rollouts for policy training in Model Context Protocol (MCP) environments. We first introduce Discord, which tests harness edits using exact paired inference and decision-preserving early stopping: only disagreeing paired outcomes favor one harness over another. This insight motivates prospective allocation in BRACE (Bank-calibrated Rollout Allocation under Correlated Episodes). BRACE combines historical task evidence, uncertainty in task success rates, and a correlated reward model to forecast mixed-reward groups before allocating generation budget. Controlled harness experiments favor Discord, while live MCP experiments expose a retention-cost trade-off. At three Qwen3-VL model scales, BRACE exceeds the strongest plotted baseline peaks with fewer new training rollouts; historical-bank collection is counted separately. It also leads the compared methods on BFCL and NESTFUL without further training. Ablations probe the bank, estimator, and allocation score; prospective evaluation checks forecast calibration. These results support forecasting reward contrast before generation.
papers.title_ja: まず測定し、その後割り当てる：強化学習におけるMCPエージェントのための較正済みロールアウト予算
papers.summary_ja: ツール使用LLMの強化学習において、報酬の不一致（ディスコード）を指標としてハーネス評価とロールアウト予算の最適割り当てを行う手法を提案する。Discordはペア推論と早期停止により効率的な比較を行い、BRACEは過去のタスク証拠と不確実性を活用して報酬の混合グループを予測し、生成コストを削減する。Qwen3-VLモデルを用いた実験では、既存ベースラインより少ない新規ロールアウトで性能を向上させ、BFCLやNESTFULベンチマークでも優位性を示した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMエージェントの強化学習効率化と推論コスト削減に直結する手法

papers.title: Is Anyone Enforcing the Cartel? What Reinforcement Learning Teaches LLM Agents in Markets
papers.summary: Evaluations of large language model (LLM) agents report that pricing agents collude at others' expense. Yet collusion is defined by enforcement: a cartel, in which competitors share monopoly profits, holds only if a member who cheats is punished. We introduce an audit that tests enforcement by forcing a member to cheat in counterfactual copies of a market, and use it to study what reinforcement learning (RL) teaches agents in pricing and trading. Small LLMs trained by RL learn what their training rivals reward, but only what they readily try. In self-play, they learn fixed rules ignoring their rivals; against a punishing rival, to be deterred; against a cheating rival, to match its cuts, never the costly price war that would deter it, which they rarely try. A war forced into training is learned, but mostly only where it was forced. Against their own copies, deterred and matching agents can earn the same cartel profits, but only matching ones can enforce them, and then thinly: as a by-product and only against large cuts. Q-learners enforce collusion only in pricing. Prompted LLMs reach cartel-like outcomes mostly through rules that ignore the market. Outcome measures cannot tell these cases apart; the audit can.
papers.title_ja: カルテルは誰が執行しているのか？強化学習がLLMエージェントに市場で教えるもの
papers.summary_ja: LLMエージェントの価格設定における共謀（カルテル）の持続可能性を、反事実的な「裏切りシナリオ」で検証する監査手法を提案する。強化学習（RL）で訓練された小型LLMは、競合の報酬構造を学習するが、コストの高い価格競争による抑止行動は稀にしか試みず、学習も限定的であることが判明した。自己対戦では競合を無視した固定ルールを学習し、罰則のある競合に対しては抑止されるが、裏切りに対しては価格引き下げを模倣するのみである。結果指標だけでは区別できないこれらの行動様式を、本監査手法により明確に識別できることを示した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMエージェント設計と強化学習の応用、評価手法の革新に関わるため

papers.title: A Mechanistic Study of Automated Failure Attribution in LLM-based Agentic Systems
papers.summary: Agentic systems have demonstrated strong capabilities on complex tasks by enabling multiple interacting large language model (LLM)-based agents to collaborate and execute subtasks in parallel. However, this collaborative structure introduces new challenges for reliably evaluating and diagnosing system failures, particularly failure attribution: tracing a system's execution to identify the agent step responsible for an incorrect final outcome. Because manually performing this task is time- and labor-intensive, recent work has turned to LLMs as judges to automate the process, referred to as automated failure attribution (AFA). These approaches assume that a sufficiently capable model can infer the failing step directly from an interaction transcript. In practice, however, direct prompting often performs poorly, which motivates follow-up work that explores various ways to improve AFA performance, including alternative prompting strategies and inference-time interventions. In this paper, we examine a more fundamental question: whether this weak behavioral performance reflects a genuine capability limitation. Using linear probes applied to internal activations, we uncover a significant \emph{knows-but-won't-say gap:} models encode sufficient information to attribute a failure correctly but fail to explicitly output the responsible step. Building on this finding, we propose \emph{grafting}, a simple manual intervention that exploits knowledge already encoded in the model to improve AFA performance without requiring ground-truth labels at inference time. Extensive evaluations across multiple LLMs and benchmark settings demonstrate that grafting consistently outperforms direct-prompting approaches, underscoring the potential of leveraging latent model knowledge for more reliable failure attribution. Our code is available at https://github.com/wendyzheng22/mi4afa.
papers.title_ja: LLMベースのエージェントシステムにおける自動障害帰属のメカニズム研究
papers.summary_ja: LLMエージェントシステムにおける障害の特定（障害帰属）を自動化する際、モデルが正解を知りながら出力しない「knows-but-won't-say gap」の存在を内部活性化の線形プローブで解明した。この潜在知識を活用するため、推論時に正解ラベルを必要としない介入手法「grafting」を提案する。複数のLLMとベンチマークでの評価により、従来の直接プロンプティング手法よりも一貫して高性能であることを示し、信頼性の高い障害診断手法として有効性を確認した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMエージェント設計と評価手法の両方に深く関連する

papers.title: LIFT: Scoped Constraints for Evaluating and Training Instruction Following
papers.summary: Common instruction following (IF) benchmarks, such as IFEval, evaluate the ability of language models (LMs) to follow simple constraints that can easily be verified programmatically. These same constraints, in turn, are used as reward signals for reinforcement learning. This design may lead to reward hacking of constraints, pushing models away from the main task. Recent attempts to address this resulted in benchmarks with richer constraints, but required expert labor, remained closed-access, and cannot be easily extended. We present Lift-Bench, an IF benchmark that asks a model to draft a document given a topic and a structured outline. Constraints are scoped to certain document sections, providing finer control over constraint density. Lift-Bench includes both verifiable and judged constraints, as well as a training counterpart, Lift-Train. Importantly, Lift-Bench provides both main task and instruction-following constraints, mitigating shallow reward hacking. On experiments with multiple models, we find that frontier models struggle with the harder subsets of our benchmark and analyze model performance along multiple axes. We also find that training on Lift-Train is much less susceptible to reward hacking than training on the common IFTrain. Lift-Bench and Lift-Train are publicly available, as well as the data generating pipeline.
papers.title_ja: LIFT: 指示追従の評価と学習のためのスコープ付き制約
papers.summary_ja: 既存の指示追従ベンチマークが持つ報酬ハッキング（制約のみを最適化し本来のタスクを疎かにする現象）を緩和するため、文書セクションごとに制約をスコープする新しいベンチマークLift-Benchと学習データセットLift-Trainを提案する。この手法は、検証可能な制約と評価者による判定制約を組み合わせ、主タスクと指示追従の両方を評価することで、浅い報酬ハッキングを抑制する。実験では、フロンティアモデルでも高難度サブセットで苦戦することが示され、Lift-Trainを用いた学習が既存手法より報酬ハッキングに耐性があることが確認された。データ生成パイプラインを含む全資産が公開されており、LLMの信頼性評価と訓練に直接応用可能である。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMの指示追従評価・訓練と報酬ハッキング対策は、ユーザーの関心であるLLM効率化・実務応用・評価手法と強く関連する。

papers.title: How Much Gradient Does Truncated Backprop Lose in Looped Transformers?
papers.summary: Looped transformers reuse one block of layers many times and are often trained by backpropagating through only the last k loops. We measure how much of the weight gradient this throws away, exactly and for every k from one backward pass, on nine looped language models, and report three findings. First, on a trained model this lost gradient is set near the output: once the loop count is well above k, it barely changes with the loop count (within about 0.03 from 32 to 64 loops on the three models we tested, as a pre-registered test predicted for Parcae). Where the backward signal shrinks, $\rho^k$, with $\rho$ the signal's fitted shrink per loop, approximates it at moderate loop counts but overstates it at long ones, because the fitted $\rho$ drifts up as the fit takes in more loops. On Ouro the signal grows, and keeping two of four loops still loses 81% of the final output's gradient. Second, the lost gradient falls during fine-tuning, by 0.07-0.22 within 300 steps on three of four models, on held-out problems too. The fall is not just the read-out's share of the gradient; training only the layers outside the loop reproduced up to half of it, and it also falls under truncated training. So a trained model's value overstates what truncation removes later. Third, we could not show that it predicts the training cost of truncation better than rules that need no measurement: on two new models it tied Parcae's cost at the same k, in a test too small to separate them.
papers.title_ja: ループ型Transformerにおける切り詰めバックプロパゲーションが失う勾配の量
papers.summary_ja: ループ型Transformerでバックプロパゲーションをk回に制限した場合、どの程度の重み勾配が失われるかを9つの言語モデルで正確に測定した。学習済みモデルでは、ループ数がkを大きく超えると失われる勾配は出力付近でほぼ一定になるが、微調整（ファインチューニング）を行うと失われる勾配は減少することが判明した。また、この測定値が切り詰め学習のコストを予測する精度は、測定不要な既存ルールと同等であり、明確な優位性は示せなかった。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMの推論・学習効率化とTransformer構造の分析に直結する

papers.title: LEAN: Loss-Engineered Modulation of the Model Weight-Sensitivity Distribution for Efficient, Error-Tolerant Neural Networks
papers.summary: The weights of a trained network do not have uniform sensitivity to model accuracy: the 1% most sensitive weights carry about a fifth of the damage a bit flip can do. This distribution decides the bit-flip tolerance of a model, the fraction of weights a code must cover and the bits each weight needs; existing schemes work with the distribution training leaves. We show that we can systematically modulate or alter the weight sensitivity distribution of a trained model, thereby shifting weights from one sensitivity bin to another. The sensitivity of a stored weight is the product of its gradient and the step a flip takes in the storage format, and LEAN adds a composite regularizer on both factors, a range term that bounds the flip step and a tail term that lowers the gradient of the most sensitive weights, with one coefficient {\lambda} setting how far the distribution moves. Ten epochs with the term, as a fine-tune or as the last epochs of training, shrink the sensitive tail 5 to 13 times on nine vision models (ResNet-18, ResNet-50, VGG-16 on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, ImageNet) within 0.5 points of accuracy; real flips confirm that the reshaped weights do less damage, a plain gradient-norm penalty does not reproduce the effect, and a preliminary extension to three small language models shows the same tail shaping. With a BCH code over 1% of the weights the model then survives 300 progressive bit-search flips in every training seed and 500 in two of three, where three of four published defenses with the same code fail by 300 and WCAT falls to 75% at 500. The reshaped distribution also cuts the parity for a fixed guarantee 3.7 times and makes a sensitivity-ordered 8/6/4/3-bit format affordable, which stores ImageNet ResNet-50 at a 3.29-bit weight payload, 2.4 times smaller than INT8, above the accuracy of LSQ at 3 bits.
papers.title_ja: LEAN: 効率的かつ誤差耐性のあるニューラルネットワークのためのモデル重み感度分布の損失工学による調整
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、訓練済みモデルの重みにおける精度への感度分布を、複合正則化項（範囲項とテール項）を用いて系統的に調整する手法「LEAN」を提案する。この手法により、最も感度の高い重みの割合を5〜13倍に縮小し、ビット反転による性能劣化を大幅に低減できることを視覚モデルで実証した。さらに、少数の重みに対するBCH符号との組み合わせにより、既存手法を大きく上回るビット反転耐性を達成し、ImageNet ResNet-50をINT8の2.4倍小さい3.29ビットで保存しつつ精度を維持する効率化を実現した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMの量子化・効率化と誤差耐性という関心に直接該当する手法

papers.title: Combating Catastrophic Forgetting in Continual Domain Adaptation via Knowledge Recasting
papers.summary: Adapting language models to new domains during post-training risks degrading previously acquired capabilities, a phenomenon commonly known as catastrophic forgetting. Existing mitigation methods largely treat forgetting as a consequence of excessive model drift. They therefore constrain updates by preserving old outputs, replaying old data, or regularizing changes to parameters and representations so that the updated model remains close to its previous state. We take a different view: Rather than pulling the updated model back toward its old state, we translate the new domain into the model's pre-existing knowledge space, making unfamiliar knowledge learnable through familiar procedures. Therefore, we propose Skill Schema Transport (SST), a post-training framework that transports new knowledge into the model's existing skill space. SST abstracts each example type into a skill schema, preserving its essential operations, dependencies, and verification steps while removing domain-specific surface forms. By recasting new examples as instances of reusable procedures, SST turns knowledge update from trajectory memorization into procedural reuse. In continual domain adaptation settings, SST consistently reduces forgetting while improving generalization to related tasks. Across two 3B instruction-tuned backbones, SST improves average final performance on streamed domains by 2.53 to 5.75 points over sequential post-training. It also lowers max-drop forgetting in all evaluated settings, with the largest reduction from 42.41 to 7.10 points on the Qwen-3B MATH stream, while substantially recovering the OOD degradation induced by sequential updates.
papers.title_ja: 知識再構築による継続的ドメイン適応におけるカタストロフィック・フォーゲッティングの克服
papers.summary_ja: 大規模言語モデルの継続的ドメイン適応において、既存能力の劣化（カタストロフィック・フォーゲッティング）を抑制する手法を提案する。従来のモデル更新を制限するアプローチとは異なり、新しい知識をモデルが既に持つ「スキル空間」に変換・統合するSkill Schema Transport (SST)フレームワークを導入する。これにより、新しいタスクを既存の手続きとして再利用可能にし、記憶の定着ではなく手続きの再利用として学習を再定義する。実験では、3Bパラメータモデルにおいて逐次ポストトレーニング比で平均性能を2.53〜5.75点上昇させ、最大で42.41点あった性能低下を7.10点まで大幅に低減した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMの継続学習と効率化、実務応用可能な手法に直結

papers.title: CSD: Common-Support Distillation for Cross-Tokenizer Knowledge Transfer
papers.summary: Cross-tokenizer logits distillation enables knowledge transfer across model families, allowing students to learn from stronger or more specialized teachers. However, differences in vocabulary and segmentation make teacher and student next-token distributions difficult to align. Existing logits-based methods are easy to integrate into standard distillation pipelines, but often rely on restrictive heuristics or tokenizer-pair-specific choices. They may restrict supervision to shared vocabulary subsets, require manually selecting different objectives for different tokenizer pairs, or match only the observed chunk and its complement rather than individual alternative continuations. We introduce Common-Support Distillation (CSD), a unified logits-based framework that constructs a shared support between the teacher and student at each aligned input chunk and matches the induced distributions with a single objective. For one-to-one alignments, CSD uses explicit common-token pairs as the shared support. For other alignments, it constructs a virtual support whose probabilities are computed using the autoregressive chain rule. A residual event captures probability mass outside the explicit support, ensuring that both induced distributions remain normalized. Across four teacher-student settings comprising Llama-3.2-1B and Gemma3-1B-PT students with Qwen and Phi teachers, CSD consistently achieves the highest average performance among the evaluated cross-tokenizer methods, outperforming the strongest alternative by up to 1.8 points and surpassing both continued pretraining and same-tokenizer distillation. For Llama-3.1-8B, CSD improves average accuracy over the strongest evaluated baseline by up to 4.2 points for the base student and 1.6 points for the instruction-tuned student.
papers.title_ja: CSD: トークナイザ間知識移転のための共通サポート蒸留
papers.summary_ja: 異なるトークナイザを持つ教師モデルと生徒モデル間の知識移転を、ロジットベースの蒸留で実現する手法「Common-Support Distillation (CSD)」を提案する。語彙やセグメンテーションの違いによる分布の不一致を解消するため、各入力チャンクごとに共通のサポート（確率空間）を構築し、単一の目的関数で分布を一致させる。1対1の対応では共通トークン対を、それ以外では自己回帰チェーンルールを用いた仮想サポートを構築し、残差イベントで正規化を保証する。LlamaやGemmaなどの小規模モデルにおいて、既存のクロス・トークナイザ手法や継続事前学習を上回る性能を達成した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMの蒸留・効率化・知識移転というユーザーの関心と直接一致する手法

papers.title: Scalable Stress-Constrained Topology Optimization: A Super-resolution and Simultaneous Approach Based on Machine Learning
papers.summary: Large-scale topology optimization (TO) remains computationally demanding, especially for stress-constrained problems. To address this challenge, we propose the simultaneous neural topology optimization (SNTO) framework where we represent state, adjoint, and design variables with custom neural networks (NNs) whose parameters are jointly optimized within a single optimization loop that leverages continuous adjoint analysis and automatic differentiation. This optimization minimizes a multi-component loss function that combines the design objective, an aggregation of the local stress constraints, and the potential energy functionals. Our NNs have a unique architecture that accelerates convergence while enabling the networks to capture sharp gradients and boundaries which are critical to stress-constrained TO. To achieve scalability to millions of degrees of freedom (DoF), we develop a hardware-aware training scheme in which the design domain is partitioned into subdomains that are distributed across multiple GPUs. To control peak GPU memory usage, we further slice each subdomain into smaller regions whose loss gradients are evaluated sequentially and accumulated to update the NN parameters. Unlike domain decomposition approaches, our partitioning naturally ensures field continuity across the subdomains and does not require the introduction of additional terms into the loss function. For validation, we first evaluate the proposed framework on various 2D stress-constrained benchmarks and compare our results to a conventional finite element-based approach, showing that SNTO produces super-resolution designs with sharper boundaries, smaller gray areas, and lower volume fractions. We then consider large-scale 3D problems with up to eight million collocation points and distribute the training over up to eight GPUs.
papers.title_ja: スケーラブルな応力制約トポロジー最適化：機械学習に基づくスーパーリゾリューションと同時アプローチ
papers.summary_ja: 応力制約付きトポロジー最適化の計算負荷を軽減するため、状態・共役・設計変数をカスタムニューラルネットワークで表現し、単一の最適化ループ内でパラメータを同時最適化するSNTOフレームワークを提案する。独自のネットワークアーキテクチャにより収束を加速し、応力制約に重要な鋭い勾配や境界を捉える。数百万自由度へのスケーラビリティを実現するため、GPU間でのサブドメイン分割とメモリ使用量制御のための逐次勾配評価を行うハードウェア認識型学習スキームを開発した。2Dベンチマークでは従来の有限要素法よりシャープな境界と低体積率の設計を、3D大規模問題では最大800万点の配置点で検証した。
papers.relevance_reason: 機械学習による構造最適化の高速化とスケーラビリティに直結する手法

papers.title: Second Thoughts: Exploring and Planning through Comparative Imagination in World Models
papers.summary: World models let agents compare imagined outcomes before acting, but an agent must still decide which alternatives to explore and when a proposed plan should replace its learned policy. We introduce SDI (Sibling Disagreement in Imagination), which connects these decisions through a shared actor-based reference. SDI compares action sequences imagined from the same model state, using repeated rollouts of the actor's own sequence to measure variation under fixed behavior. This reference scales both the spread across candidate returns, which provides an exploration signal, and a proposed plan's predicted advantage, which governs action acceptance. The agent executes a planned action when its advantage exceeds the reference variability by a fixed factor; otherwise, it follows the actor. SDI reuses the base agent's world model, actor, and critic without requiring an additional disagreement ensemble. Exploration and planning guide training data collection, while evaluation uses the learned actor alone. Across Meta-World, Adroit, and DM-Control, SDI achieves a higher observed task-average score than every compared baseline in each suite and matches or exceeds the strongest baseline's performance on 15 of 18 tasks. Component ablations and robustness analyses further examine the roles of exploration, planning exposure, and action acceptance. Paired evaluations from identical simulator states show that the gate improves both recovery from actor failures and preservation of successful behavior relative to ungated planning, while substantially reducing return degradation. Together, these results support comparing imagined alternatives against a shared actor reference as a unified approach to exploring and planning with world models.
papers.title_ja: 第二の思考：ワールドモデルにおける比較想像を通じた探索と計画
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、ワールドモデルを用いたエージェントの探索と計画決定を統合する手法SDI（Sibling Disagreement in Imagination）を提案する。同一モデル状態から想像される行動列のバリエーションを基準とし、計画された行動の利得がその変動を超えた場合のみ実行するゲート機構を導入する。これにより、追加のアンサンブル不要で探索シグナルと行動受容を制御し、Meta-Worldなどのベンチマークで既存ベースラインを上回る性能を達成した。
papers.relevance_reason: 強化学習とワールドモデルによる計画・探索の高度な手法であり、ML手法全般の関心に合致

papers.title: Extreme Low-State Quantized Transformer for Electricity-Load Forecasting
papers.summary: Aggressive low-state weight quantization can substantially reduce neural-network representational flexibility, making predictive performance difficult to preserve when only a few discrete weight states are available. We investigate this regime for Transformer-based electricity-load forecasting using 3-, 5-, 7-, and 16-state weight quantization across feed-forward-only and attention-plus-feed-forward quantization. Two tasks predict either the next hour or the next 24 hours from the preceding 48 hours across two co-primary electricity-consumption datasets. Direct post-training quantization (PTQ) increased mean normalized root-mean-square error (NRMSE) relative to full precision by 6.25 and 7.04 percentage points in Datasets A and B, whereas quantization-aware fine-tuning (QAT-FT) recovered approximately 90.2% and 94.5% of these penalties. Quantization-aware training from random initialization (Scratch-QAT) also produced competitive low-state solutions, with particularly favorable behavior at three states. We further introduce accumulated-update thresholding, which accumulates optimizer-proposed weight changes before commitment. Relative to paired Scratch-QAT controls, this reduced committed shadow-weight updates by approximately 99.7% and discrete state transitions by approximately 77--80%, while mean NRMSE changed by only +0.042 and +0.197 percentage points. These results show that useful Transformer forecasting can be retained under highly discrete weight representations while strongly suppressing target-state activity, supporting a prospective route toward compact, low-activity edge forecasting using multilevel synaptic devices.
papers.title_ja: 電力負荷予測のための極低状態量子化トランスフォーマー
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、電力負荷予測におけるトランスフォーマーの極端な低状態（3〜16状態）重み量子化を調査する。直接の訓練後量子化（PTQ）は性能を大きく劣化させるが、量子化認識ファインチューニング（QAT-FT）やスクラッチからの量子化認識訓練（Scratch-QAT）により、ほぼ90%以上の性能損失を回復できることを示す。さらに、オプティマイザの更新を蓄積してから適用する「蓄積更新閾値法」を提案し、コミットされた重み更新を約99.7%、離散状態遷移を約77〜80%削減しながら、精度劣化を最小限に抑えた。これにより、多レベルシナプティックデバイスを用いたコンパクトで低アクティビティのエッジ推論への応用可能性が示唆される。
papers.relevance_reason: LLM/Transformerの量子化・効率化と推論高速化に直結する手法

papers.title: An Explicit Feedback Contract for Iterative ML-Agent Harnesses
papers.summary: Iterative ML agents develop models by editing code, running experiments, reading a validation score, and choosing what to try next. In current harnesses this loop is served by an exact validation score returned after every attempt, which leaves the validation split open to adaptive selection. In this work, we introduce an explicit feedback contract for ML-agent harnesses, which specifies what an agent may observe, when iteration should stop, and when the test split may be touched. The contract releases a validation score only when a submission clears a noise threshold computed from the paired standard error, so no margin has to be tuned. We ran experiments on click-through-rate prediction, learning to rank, and a control task with no signal to find. The control is the sharpest case, because the true gain there is zero by construction: an agent reading exact scores ended by reporting a gain of 0.0157, while under the contract it reported 0.0033. On both real tasks the contract narrows the validation-test gap, and test performance is slightly higher rather than lower. The largest difference is in when the agents stop. Exact feedback used its entire budget of thirty submissions on two of the three tasks, including the one where nothing can be learned, while the contract halted after four to twelve. A run that exhausts its budget is usually read as diligence. It is better read as a symptom: when the feedback channel is unbounded, noise keeps supplying improvements to chase.
papers.title_ja: 反復型MLエージェントハーネスのための明示的なフィードバック契約
papers.summary_ja: 反復的にモデルを改善するMLエージェントにおいて、検証スコアを無制限に参照することで生じる適応的選択バイアス（過学習）を抑制する手法を提案する。ペア標準誤差から計算されるノイズ閾値を超えた場合のみスコアを公開する「フィードバック契約」を導入し、エージェントが観察できる情報と停止条件を明確に定義した。クリック率予測やランキング学習などの実験では、この契約により検証セットとテストセットの乖離が縮小し、テスト性能がわずかに向上した。特にシグナルが存在しない制御タスクにおいて、エージェントがノイズを追って無駄な試行を繰り返すのを防ぎ、早期に停止させる効果を確認した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMエージェント設計と評価手法の改善に直結する実務的貢献

papers.title: When Do Gaussian Priors Fail? A Latent Geometry Investigation of RL Fine-Tuning
papers.summary: Latent diffusion models almost universally place a Gaussian prior on the VAE latent space. For base generation this default is unproblematic; under reinforcement-learning fine-tuning, however, it carries a structural limitation. The standard VAE's KL term does not merely ignore mode structure - it actively taxes separation and tightness. When data are multimodal, the ELBO optimum compresses distinct modes into an overlapping latent. RL fine-tuning amplifies this overlap: the score network is under-resolved on the saddle region between modes, dynamic-to-variational amplification rises sharply, and the collapse boundary beta_c is pushed far above its variational scale. On the real alanine-dipeptide Boltzmann distribution, a Gaussian-prior VAE collapses at beta_c = 0.224 while a mode-tracked Gaussian-mixture prior collapses at 0.00316, a 71x gap from the same pipeline. We trace this gap to a single geometric mediator, d_min/(2 sigma_0), and verify the causal chain through controlled interventions: moving geometry at fixed prior, and switching prior at matched geometry (full mediation; prior-label coefficient 0.995x, 95% CI [0.79, 1.25]). A three-source decomposition localises the amplification to the learned policy (zero ODE-solver contribution, bounded anchor mismatch); the coverage plateau is an unconditional benefit of mode-separating priors that no amount of RL capacity recovers. The remedy is conditional: a non-Gaussian prior is necessary precisely when the latent geometry would fall into overlap and the task is coverage-sensitive. A machine-checked theory skeleton supports the KL pricing structure - a divergent compactness tax under a Gaussian prior versus a finite assignment fee under a mixture - and the position-versus-plateau distinction delimits what is finite-resource from what requires changing the prior.
papers.title_ja: ガウス先験が失敗する条件：強化学習ファインチューニングにおける潜在幾何学の調査
papers.summary_ja: 潜在拡散モデルにおける標準的なガウス先験が、強化学習（RL）ファインチューニング時に多峰性データに対して構造的な限界を持つことを指摘する。KL項がモードの分離を抑制し、RLによってこの重複が拡大して崩壊閾値が上昇するメカニズムを幾何学的に解明した。アラニンジペプチドのボルツマン分布を用いた実験では、ガウス混合先験がガウス先験比で71倍の性能差を示し、この差が潜在空間の幾何学（d_min/(2 sigma_0)）によって完全に媒介されることを因果介入により検証した。タスクがカバレッジに敏感で潜在幾何学が重複領域に落ちる場合のみ、非ガウス先験が必須であるという条件付きの解決策を提示している。
papers.relevance_reason: RLとガウス過程・ベイズ的視点の融合、および理論的検証手法が関心に合致

papers.title: Self-Supervised Tuning of Low-Fidelity Optimization Models via High-Fidelity Feedback
papers.summary: Low-fidelity (LF) optimization models are widely used in large-scale operations because they can be solved efficiently and reliably, but they often exhibit systematic errors relative to high-fidelity (HF) formulations that better capture physical and operational constraints. Existing learning-based approaches typically rely on supervised or semi-supervised training with HF solutions, which are expensive to compute and may not align with HF operational objectives. We propose a self-supervised framework that parameterizes LF optimization models directly from HF feedback. The low-fidelity problem is embedded as a differentiable optimization layer and trained end-to-end, while a HF correction problem evaluates its solution and provides gradient information through its dual variables, without requiring HF solution labels. We evaluate the framework on optimal power flow, optimal gas flow, and pooling problems, spanning different sources of low- and high-fidelity mismatch. Across all three applications, the self-supervised approach improves objective quality and feasibility over untuned LF models and generally outperforms semi-supervised training. The learned parameterizations also generalize to unseen operating conditions and, for network applications with up to 30,000 nodes, to systems not encountered during training.
papers.title_ja: 高忠実度フィードバックを用いた低忠実度最適化モデルの自己教師ありチューニング
papers.summary_ja: 低忠実度（LF）最適化モデルの系統的誤差を、高忠実度（HF）モデルの解ラベルなしで補正する自己教師ありフレームワークを提案する。LF問題を微分可能最適化層として埋め込み、HF補正問題の双対変数から勾配情報を得ることでエンドツーエンド学習を実現した。電力フロー、ガスフロー、プーリング問題において、半教師あり学習より高い目的関数品質と実現可能性を示し、最大3万ノードの未見システムへも汎化できることを確認した。
papers.relevance_reason: サロゲートモデルの精度向上と最適化手法の組み合わせが関心に合致

papers.title: Speedrunning Relational Foundation Model Pretraining
papers.summary: Progress on foundation model pretraining is gated by who can afford a trial, and relational pretraining is no exception. Recipes are developed inside individual labs, reported under private protocols, and do not accumulate. Speedrun leaderboards remove that barrier by decentralizing the search rather than the training run. The problem is fixed, the stack is open, entries are ranked by wall-clock time to a quality target, and one GPU is enough to hold the record. We introduce modded-nanoRT, the first such leaderboard for Relational Transformers. Which database to hold out decides whether the benchmark can resolve improvements at all, so we fix it by calibration, ranking six candidates by how sharply a 45-minute learning curve separates improvement from seed noise. We open the leaderboard with typed trilinear attention, a relational operator that conditions attention scores and values on the foreign key traversed, together with Muon and SIGReg. The recipe reaches the target in 305.63 seconds on one NVIDIA H200, 8.11x faster than the reference implementation, and wins 13 of 15 pairs outside the development database. We will release the benchmark, its frozen artifacts, and the record runs. Our code is available at https://github.com/kunumi/nanoRT.
authors: Gabriel Wedson Mendon\c{c}a de Souza Veloso
papers.title_ja: 関係性基盤モデルの事前学習のスピードランニング
papers.summary_ja: 関係性トランスフォーマー（Relational Transformer）の事前学習において、試行コストの壁を打破するため、壁時計時間（wall-clock time）でランキングする「スピードラン」リーダーボードを提案する。データベースの選択をキャリブレーションで固定し、型付き三線形アテンションやMuonオプティマイザを用いたレシピを開発した。この手法は1枚のNVIDIA H200 GPU上で305.63秒で目標品質に到達し、参照実装比で8.11倍高速化を実現した。ベンチマークとコードは公開され、分散型での性能探索を可能にする。
papers.relevance_reason: LLM効率化・推論高速化・ベンチマーク設計の関心に強く合致

papers.title: Brittle by Design? Multi-Scenario Reinforcement Learning for Robust Mission Coordination in Systems of Systems
papers.summary: As systems engineering (SE) shifts from monolithic systems to Systems of Systems, Mission Engineering (ME) has emerged as a new line of thinking in SE. Mission environments are uncertain and dynamic, and outcomes depend on how mission assets interact with them, rendering static architectures brittle and calling for flexible yet analytically rigorous ME approaches. We propose an intelligent mission coordination methodology integrating high-fidelity digital mission models with Reinforcement Learning (RL) for adaptive task allocation. Using a Digital Engineering (DE) infrastructure comprising a digital mission model and agent-based simulation, we formulate mission tactics management as a Markov Decision Process and train an RL coordinator with Proximal Policy Optimization to map mission states to tactical actions from realized outcomes. An aerial firefighting mission with three scenarios demonstrates the approach. First, all trained coordinators significantly outperform random and heuristic baselines. Second, single-scenario coordinators can be brittle: the coordinator trained on the more forgiving scenario degrades to random tactics performance in more demanding scenarios, whereas the demanding-scenario coordinator retains most of its advantage when transferred. Third, within the same training budget, a coordinator trained on both scenarios concurrently matches the scenario-specific coordinators in their own scenarios and significantly outperforms every other policy. Sensitivity analyses on ignition location, weather, scenario, and training curricula show that the variability represented during training shapes post-deployment performance. This proof of concept shows DE-enabled mission simulations combined with RL offer a reusable methodology for improving ME practice, which can be extended to fleet design and selection from a mission-first perspective.
papers.title_ja: 設計上の脆さ？システム・オブ・システムにおける堅牢なミッション調整のためのマルチシナリオ強化学習
papers.summary_ja: システム・オブ・システム環境下でのミッション調整において、デジタルエンジニアリング基盤と強化学習（RL）を統合した適応型タスク割当手法を提案する。近接方策最適化（PPO）を用いたRLコーディネータを訓練し、航空消防ミッションの3シナリオで検証した結果、ランダムやヒューリスティックベースラインを大きく上回った。単一シナリオで訓練したモデルは他シナリオで性能が低下する脆さを示すが、複数シナリオを同時訓練したモデルは全シナリオで高い性能を維持し、汎用性と堅牢性を両立させることを実証した。
papers.relevance_reason: 強化学習とマルチシナリオ適応という手法が関心に合致

papers.title: An Implicit Conservative Finite Volume Scheme with Poisson Brackets for the Steady-State Transport of Galactic Cosmic Rays
papers.summary: Galactic cosmic rays (GCRs) pose a persistent radiation hazard to astronauts and spacecraft in the heliosphere. Modeling their transport is essential for understanding how the solar wind and heliospheric magnetic field shape their spatial distributions and energy spectra. Timely predictions require solving for the particle distribution function much faster than real time, but explicit numerical schemes are restricted by the stability limit on the time step. In this Letter, we present an implicit conservative finite-volume scheme for kinetic equations formulated with Poisson brackets. This scheme conserves particle number, maintains the total-variation-diminishing property, achieves second-order spatial accuracy, and remains stable for time steps far beyond the explicit limit, while reaching quasi-steady states in less than ~1/100 of the computational time required for the explicit scheme, as demonstrated by numerical tests. We apply this scheme to the Parker transport equation along magnetic field lines in the background solar wind during Carrington rotation 2211, where it reaches steady-state GCR distributions within 10 iterations, about 1000 times faster than the explicit scheme. The GCR proton spectrum averaged over 27 days agrees with AMS-02 measurements to within 10%. The simulation also yields a realistic radial intensity gradient and captures the Forbush decrease features associated with three stream interaction regions observed at Earth.
papers.title_ja: 銀河宇宙線の定常状態輸送に対するポアソン括弧を用いた暗黙型保存型有限体積スキーム
papers.summary_ja: 銀河宇宙線（GCR）の輸送方程式を解く際、明示的数値スキームの時間ステップ制限による計算時間の問題を解決するため、ポアソン括弧で定式化された運動論方程式に対する暗黙型保存型有限体積スキームを提案する。本手法は粒子数保存と全変動減少性を保ちつつ、明示的スキームの安定性限界を大きく超える時間ステップで安定に計算可能である。数値実験では、定常状態への収束に明示的スキームの約1/100の計算時間しか要せず、特にパーカー輸送方程式への適用では約1000倍の高速化を実現した。得られたプロトンスペクトルはAMS-02観測値と10%以内で一致し、フォブッシュ減衰などの物理現象も再現している。
papers.relevance_reason: 宇宙線輸送の高速数値解法であり、軌道力学とは異なるが計算効率化の手法として関連。

papers.title: Multi-Objective Protein Optimization via Modular Diffusion Steering
papers.summary: Protein engineering often requires improving several properties simultaneously, motivating the search for high-performing sequences that represent useful fitness tradeoffs. Discovering these sequences is challenging because the design space is combinatorially large and experimental campaigns often permit only a few rounds of batched measurements. We introduce \textit{MODS}, a modular framework for multi-objective protein optimization via inference-time diffusion steering. For each proposal, MODS samples augmented Chebyshev scalarization weights and a fitness-surrogate ensemble member to define a scalar steering reward. Varying the weights directs generation toward different objective tradeoffs, while varying ensemble members diversifies the predictions used for guidance. Because MODS expresses multi-objective acquisition through scalar rewards, it can be paired with different diffusion models and compatible steering procedures. After each evaluation batch, MODS updates the surrogates without retraining the generative model. We evaluate MODS on six protein optimization tasks using predictive oracles trained on experimental assay data, with two diffusion models and two steering procedures. MODS achieves competitive final hypervolume across all six tasks with both diffusion models, and substantially outperforms the best evaluated baseline on several tasks. Our results demonstrate a flexible and effective approach to multi-objective protein optimization with limited feedback.
papers.title_ja: モジュール拡散ステアリングによる多目的タンパク質最適化
papers.summary_ja: MODSは、推論時の拡散モデルステアリングを用いた多目的タンパク質最適化のためのモジュール型フレームワークである。チェビシェフスカラー化重みとフィッネスサロゲートアンサンブルを組み合わせることで、異なる目的間のトレードオフや予測の多様性を制御する。評価バッチごとにサロゲートのみを更新し、生成モデルの再学習を不要とする設計が特徴である。実験データを用いた6つのタスクにおいて、既存ベースラインを上回る競争力のある結果を示した。
papers.relevance_reason: サロゲートモデルと多目的最適化の手法は関連するが、対象がタンパク質であり軌道力学ではないため

papers.title: Group Distributionally Robust Optimization over Decentralized Networks
papers.summary: We study group distributionally robust optimization (GDRO) over decentralized networks, where workers collaborate to learn robust models by minimizing the maximum local risk. Existing methods optimize only dual-regularized surrogates and establish guarantees for a globally averaged model that is not available to workers. In this paper, we directly optimize the original GDRO objective and establish guarantees for local models in semi-decentralized (SemiDec) and fully decentralized (Dec) settings. A key difficulty is that applying the primal-dual decomposition from centralized GDRO yields worker-dependent losses whose evaluation requires unavailable cross-worker information. To address this challenge, we develop a novel error decomposition that recasts decentralized GDRO as (i) a decentralized online convex optimization (D-OCO) problem and a prediction-with-expert-advice problem in SemiDec, and as (ii) two coupled D-OCO problems in Dec, with discrepancy terms capturing inconsistencies among local decisions. By isolating consensus errors in analysis, we develop modular frameworks that support different consensus routines. We then establish the \emph{first} per-worker convergence guarantees for optimizing the original GDRO objective over decentralized networks. Instantiations with accelerated gossip and Choco-gossip achieve an $O(\sqrt{(\log m)/T})$ convergence rate over $T$ update rounds, while experiments demonstrate improved worst-worker performance over baselines.
papers.title_ja: 分散ネットワークにおけるグループ分布的頑健最適化
papers.summary_ja: 分散型ネットワーク環境下でのグループ分布的頑健最適化（GDRO）手法を提案する。既存手法が双対正則化された代理目的関数を最適化するのに対し、本論文は元のGDRO目的関数を直接最適化し、各ワーカーのローカルモデルに対する収束保証を確立する。分散環境特有の課題であるワーカー間情報の欠如に対し、分散オンライン凸最適化（D-OCO）や予測問題への定式化変換を行うことで、コンセンサス誤差を分離したモジュール型フレームワークを構築した。加速化ゴシップやChoco-gossipを用いることで、更新ラウンドTに対してO(√((log m)/T))の収束率を実現し、最悪ケースの性能向上を実験で示した。
papers.relevance_reason: 分散最適化の理論的進展であり、ML手法全般に関わるが、LLMや軌道力学との直接の関連は薄い。

papers.title: Generalization Bounds via Vector-Valued $L_p$ Correlation $V_\alpha$
papers.summary: Understanding generalization of randomized learning algorithms remains a central challenge. Mutual-information and total-variation bounds provide complementary ways to quantify data--hypothesis dependence, but they can behave quite differently in high-dimensional regimes. We study a one-parameter family of dependence measures, the vector-valued $L_p$-norm correlation $V_\alpha$, and derive generalization bounds whose dependence terms interpolate between total variation (TV) at $\alpha=1$ and variance and $\chi^2$ related behavior at $\alpha=2$. For $\alpha>2$, the H\"older-conjugate loss moment is below two, yielding heavy-tailed specializations that can remain finite even when the loss variance is infinite. A particularly interpretable specialization occurs at $\alpha=2$, where the bound can be expressed in terms of the variability of the algorithm's output density across datasets, $\int \sqrt{\mathrm{Var}_S[p(w\mid S)]}~ dw$. We show that the entire $V_\alpha$ family is invariant under smooth bijective reparameterizations of the hypothesis space. We also introduce an adaptive density stability (ADS) condition that implies explicit control of $V_2$, and we verify it for Gibbs-type posteriors under bounded losses (yielding rates that depend on the inverse temperature and sample size). To address scaling, we extend the framework to a conditional formulation using supersamples, analogous in spirit to conditional mutual information (CMI), and discuss evaluations in the output space as a practical surrogate for estimating dependence. Simulations on Bayesian linear regression illustrate how tuning $\alpha$ can change the tightness of the resulting bounds across regimes. Additional supersample experiments on noisy MNIST and on a pretrained ResNet-50 for CIFAR-10 show similar behavior of the projected loss-space bounds beyond the original clean-MNIST setting.
papers.title_ja: ベクトル値 $L_p$ 相関 $V_ eta$ による汎化境界
papers.summary_ja: ランダム化学習アルゴリズムの汎化性能を評価する新たな依存度指標 $V_\alpha$ を提案し、総変動距離と分散の間に補間する汎化境界を導出した。この指標は仮説空間の滑らかな再パラメータ化に対して不変であり、重尾分布の損失関数に対しても有限な境界を提供できる。さらに、適応的密度安定性条件を導入し、ギブス型事後分布における明示的な制御を確立した。ベイズ線形回帰や ResNet-50 を用いたシミュレーションにより、パラメータ調整による境界の緊密さの変化を実証した。
papers.relevance_reason: 機械学習理論の汎化境界であり、手法全般に関心はあるが軌道力学やLLM効率化とは直接無関係

papers.title: Density-Level Backward Error for Low-NFE Generative Flows
papers.summary: Low-NFE generative ODE sampling is constrained not only by solver order, but also by how a fixed budget of network evaluations is distributed along the flow. We develop a density-level backward-error framework that identifies the component of a solver's modified-equation defect that changes the evolving marginal, while excluding solenoidal trajectory distortion that is invisible in Wasserstein tangent geometry. The resulting residual induces a solver-order-aware compute-allocation rule and, through gauge freedom, an objective for selecting numerically favorable velocity representatives of the same density path. This separates our approach from schedule search driven by trajectory or endpoint surrogates and from higher-order solver design. Exact Gaussian and mixture models establish the mechanism, including cases where curvature-based allocation fails and continuum-optimal transport is not discretization-optimal. On a pretrained CIFAR-10 EDM probability-flow ODE, density-aware allocation consistently improves fixed-update Euler sampling in the low-NFE regime. Matched-seed convergence to a dense Euler reference confirms that the method accelerates approximation of the same high-NFE flow rather than changing the asymptotic sampler.
papers.title_ja: 低NFE生成フローにおける密度レベル後方誤差
papers.summary_ja: 低NFE（ネットワーク評価回数）制約下での生成ODEサンプリングにおいて、ソルバの順序だけでなく、計算予算の配分が精度に与える影響を分析する枠組みを提案する。密度レベルの後方誤差を用い、マージナル分布の変化に影響する成分のみを抽出し、ソルバ順序を考慮した計算資源の最適配分ルールを導出する。ガウス分布や混合モデルによる理論的検証に加え、CIFAR-10 EDMモデルにおいて、この密度認識型配分が固定ステップEuler法を改善し、高密度参照への収束を加速させることを実証した。
papers.relevance_reason: 数値ODE解法の最適化であり、ML手法全般に関わるが軌道力学とは無関係

papers.title: LLMs as survey respondents: Comparison to simple semantic baselines
papers.summary: Large language models (LLMs) have been explored as surrogates for human survey respondents. A more promising application is data augmentation, where LLMs predict new responses from partial human data. However, the semantic similarity between questionnaire items is a known source of correlation between answers. It is thus unclear whether LLMs actually infer meaningful relationships between question-response pairs, or use surface-level comparison between questions as a heuristic. To assess this, we evaluated how three LLMs can predict responses to held-out items in two surveys measuring attitudes toward automated or light-electric vehicles, based on varying proportions of known responses. Performance was compared to two baselines, where new responses were derived by maximizing embedding-similarity to a prior response. While LLMs mostly predicted human responses better than baselines, their performance consistently declined with a lower share of known responses, even aligning with the baseline in one survey. Our results show that LLMs' capacities for augmenting replies varied across surveys, and can revert to the same levels as simpler embedding similarity baselines when less data is available.
papers.title_ja: LLMを調査回答者として利用：単純なセマンティックベースラインとの比較
papers.summary_ja: 大規模言語モデル（LLM）が人間調査の回答を予測・補完する能力を、埋め込み類似性に基づく単純なベースラインと比較して評価した。自動運転車や軽電気車への態度を測る2つの調査データを用い、既知回答の割合を変えて予測精度を検証した。LLMは多くの場合ベースラインを上回ったが、既知データが少ない場合、性能が低下しベースラインと同等になる傾向が見られた。この結果は、LLMが意味的な関係性を深く推論しているのではなく、質問間の表面的な類似性を活用している可能性を示唆している。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMの限界評価だが、軌道力学や物理モデルとの直接関連は薄い

papers.title: ExGrad: Beyond Suppression - Explicit Clean-Gradient Subtraction in Adversarial Training
papers.summary: Adversarial training derives updates from surrogate losses, but source-loss descent does not directly characterize an update's effect on adversarial margins. We introduce ExGrad (extrapolative gradient recomposition), which constructs clean-input, adversarial-input, and adversarial-weight-perturbed (AWP) gradients. Virtual steps measure their margin responses, and a globally solvable three-variable problem selects coefficients over a bounded affine domain without nonnegativity constraints. Across affine radii on CIFAR-10, negative clean coefficients rapidly predominate and increase in magnitude with the radius. Cross-zero interventions show that setting the clean coefficient to zero is insufficient: mild subtraction improves PGD-20, while stronger subtraction trades clean accuracy for further PGD-20 gains. In CIFAR-10 WRN-28-4 controls, none of the three candidate-removal variants matches full ExGrad. Projection diagnostics show that negative clean coefficients usually coexist with positive net clean-axis projections, although both decrease as the radius grows. Norm-matched controls indicate that update magnitude alone does not explain the moderate-radius gains. Experiments on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and ImageNet-100 show radius-dependent improvements over AWP. On CIFAR-100, ExGrad at $R=0.8$ improves all five reported metrics, including clean and AutoAttack accuracy by 3.84 and 1.75 percentage points. On ImageNet-100, the same radius improves all four robust metrics over both AWP and PGD-AT. These results identify clean-gradient subtraction as a response-revealed update preference whose strength and clean-robust operating point are controlled by the affine radius.
papers.title_ja: ExGrad: 抑制を超えて - 敵対的学習における明示的なクリーングラデント減算
papers.summary_ja: 敵対的学習における更新則を改善する手法ExGradを提案する。クリーン入力、敵対的入力、敵対的重み摂動の3つの勾配を用い、有界アフィン領域上で係数を最適化することで、敵対的マージンへの影響を明示的に制御する。実験により、負のクリーングラデント係数（減算）がPGD-20などの頑健性を向上させることを示し、その強度がアフィン半径によって制御されることを確認した。CIFAR-100やImageNet-100において、既存手法AWPやPGD-ATを上回る頑健性とクリーン精度のバランスを実現した。
papers.relevance_reason: 敵対的頑健性というML手法全般に関わるが、ユーザーの関心であるLLM効率化や軌道力学とは直接無関係。

papers.title: Machine Learning-Enabled Wireless Power Transfer: A Task-Oriented Review of Structural Optimization, State and Parameter Estimation, and Adaptive Control
papers.summary: Wireless power transfer (WPT) systems must maintain efficient and safe energy delivery under variations in geometry, coupling, load, alignment, and operating conditions. Machine-learning methods are increasingly applied to accelerate structural design, estimate operating parameters and states, and support adaptive control and scheduling. This review develops a task-oriented framework organized around three interconnected domains: structural design and optimization, parameter and state estimation, and control and optimization. Supervised learning, reinforcement learning, and hybrid or physics-informed methods are compared in terms of data requirements, dependence on physical models, information sources, computational requirements, accuracy, online response, application scope, and optimization objectives. Supervised learning provides rapid surrogate modeling, regression, and classification when representative labeled data are available. Reinforcement learning addresses sequential control and scheduling but introduces challenges in reward design, safe exploration, and simulation-to-reality transfer. Hybrid methods integrate physical knowledge with data-driven models to improve data efficiency and physical consistency. The principal barriers to engineering deployment include limited and biased datasets, weak out-of-distribution generalization, insufficient physical consistency, unsafe online adaptation, embedded-resource constraints, and the absence of standardized benchmarks. Future research should prioritize uncertainty-aware and physics-informed learning, safe simulation-to-reality transfer, lightweight edge deployment, distributed coordination, reproducible evaluation, and digital-twin-assisted development.
papers.title_ja: 機械学習を活用した無線電力伝送：構造最適化、状態・パラメータ推定、適応制御のタスク志向レビュー

papers.title: Online Seakeeping Forecast Coupling System Identification With Nonlinear Pseudo Spectral Potential-Flow
papers.summary: This paper presents a grey-box framework for a robust deterministic, real-time prediction of coupled surge-heave-pitch motion in waves. The approach combines a physics-based online system identification with a nonlinear pseudo-spectral potential flow solver. Rather than prescribing a complete hydrodynamic model from captive model tests or relying on a black-box surrogate, three coupled compact, dynamics equations are identified with constrained ridge-regression of a short time-history of free-running body motion data in waves. The PSPF solver is then used to provide the future incident wave at the body's location. The PSPF and dynamic system models are coupled for continuous real-time future motion prediction in a receding horizon architecture, while the model coefficients are re-identified online to enable robust prediction to changing wave-conditions. This novel framework is demonstrated based on CFD data that has been validated for a freely floating two-dimensional rectangular box in waves. The results demonstrate a feasible framework for accurate motion forecasting up to around eight wavelengths into the future utilising data that can be gathered onboard a ship in real operations. Furthermore, it is shown that the framework is robust to changing sea-states and agnostic to underlying model geometry.
papers.title_ja: 非線形擬似スペクトル法によるポテンシャルフローとシステム同定を結合したオンライン耐波性能予測
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、波中における船舶の縦揺れ・上下動・ピッチング運動をリアルタイムで予測するグレーボックス型フレームワークを提案する。物理ベースのオンラインシステム同定と非線形擬似スペクトル法（PSPF）ソルバを組み合わせ、拘束付きリッジ回帰により動的方程式の係数を短時間データから同定する。PSPFで未来の入射波を予測し、動的モデルと結合することで、変化する海象条件にも頑健に最大約8波長先の運動を予測可能であることをCFDデータで実証した。

papers.title: Physics-Informed Mixed Integer Programming Methods for Optimal Patch Antennas
papers.summary: Antennas come in various shapes and sizes, as their performance characteristics are very much dependent on their exact shape. Coming up with a shape that matches desired design characteristics has, up until this moment, been largely the domain of metaheuristics and local optimization methods. While these methods are convenient, they generally provide no performance guarantees and rarely allow to enforce hard design constraints. In this paper, we show how Mixed-Integer Programming (MIP) can be used to optimize the shape of so-called patch antennas. The methodological focus is to show how underlying laws of physics allow to derive effective bounds on variables as well as new cutting planes. These greatly improve the effectiveness of the underlying basic MIP model, enabling the automated design of practically relevant patch antennas for a wide variety of applications.
papers.title_ja: パッチアンテナの最適設計のための物理情報混合整数計画法
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、パッチアンテナの形状最適化に混合整数計画法（MIP）を適用する手法を提案する。従来のメタヒューリスティクスや局所最適化手法では性能保証や厳密な制約条件の適用が困難であったが、本手法では物理法則に基づき変数の有効な境界やカットプレーンを導出する。これにより、MIPモデルの計算効率を大幅に向上させ、実用的なアンテナ設計の自動化を実現した。

papers.title: CALLIOPE: Private Insights into AI Use, Without Embeddings
papers.summary: We introduce CALLIOPE, a top-down framework for discovering topic hierarchies in large corpora of unstructured data (e.g., LLM conversations), while supporting differential privacy (DP). Unlike traditional and even recent LLM-augmented approaches that ultimately rely on clustering vector embeddings, our framework leverages LLM capabilities directly for the entire pipeline. Experiments demonstrate that this approach provides better utility over existing (embedding-based) methods in the DP setting, especially in the high privacy regime. We evaluate the quality of CALLIOPE outputs using a variety of traditionally studied clustering metrics, as well as some novel utility metrics that we introduce.
papers.title_ja: CALLIOPE: 埋め込みなしでAI利用のプライベートな洞察を得る
papers.summary_ja: CALLIOPEは、LLM会話などの非構造化データからトピック階層を発見するトップダウン型フレームワークである。従来のベクトル埋め込みとクラスタリングに依存する手法とは異なり、パイプライン全体でLLMの能力を直接活用する。差分プライバシー（DP）を支援しつつ、特にプライバシー要件が高い環境で既存の埋め込みベース手法よりも高いユーティリティを実現する。従来のクラスタリング指標に加え、新規に提案したユーティリティ指標を用いて出力品質を評価している。

papers.title: Is Refusal Direction Universal across Low-Resourced Languages?
papers.summary: Refusal directions have been shown to transfer cross-lingually with near-perfect effectiveness across safety-aligned languages (Wang et al., 2025), reportedly regardless of resource level. However, the only truly low-resourced language evaluated is Yoruba, which is strongly misaligned and shows limited transfer, leaving open how refusal directions behave for other low-resourced languages. We extend PolyRefuse to three additional low-resourced languages (Belarusian, Bashkir, and Tajik) and replicate the pipeline of (Wang et al., 2025) on Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct. We find that universality is graded rather than binary: directions from safety-aligned and partially-aligned languages transfer broadly, while those from strongly misaligned languages fail to reliably modulate refusal behavior on any target tested, including other misaligned languages, once ceiling effects are accounted for. Geometric alignment and behavioral transfer are further shown to be partially dissociated. These findings complicate the universality claim and suggest that users of the least-resourced, most strongly misaligned languages may face weaker safety guarantees.
papers.title_ja: 拒否方向は低リソース言語間で普遍的か？
papers.summary_ja: 本研究は、LLMの安全性における「拒否方向」が低リソース言語間でどのように転移するかを調査した。ベラルーシ語、バシキル語、タジク語の3言語を用いてQwen2.5-14B-Instruct上で実験を行い、安全性が整った言語からの方向は広く転移する一方、強く不一致な言語からの方向は信頼性のある制御効果が得られないことを示した。幾何学的な整合性と行動的な転移は部分的に分離されており、低リソース言語の安全性保証には限界があることが判明した。

papers.title: Solar System Surface Technosignatures: Searching for Signs of Artificial Design on Extraterrestrial Terrain
papers.summary: Artificial radio emissions have historically been a major focus of technosignature searches. Here, we apply an anthropological lens to expand this scope to surface technosignatures: non-random, intentional patterning on planetary terrain, similar to long-lasting human-made landscapes and monuments on Earth. On geologically inactive bodies such as the Moon and Mars, artificial traces and patterns could potentially remain visible for hundreds of millions of years. We discuss two recent developments that make this search timely: high-resolution imaging datasets, such as those produced by the HiRISE camera on the Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter (MRO), and ML-based anomaly-detection methods. Finally, we list two possible approaches to developing a model capable of searching for these surface technosignatures: a supervised and an unsupervised one. Complemented by LiDAR, ground-penetrating radar, and reflectance spectroscopy, these methods would enable the first quantitative upper limits on surface technosignatures while yielding ancillary benefits for planetary science.
papers.title_ja: 太陽系表面の技術痕跡：異星地形における人工設計の兆候の探査
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、従来の電波探査に加え、月や火星などの地質的に不活性な天体の表面に残る人工的なパターン（技術痕跡）を検出する手法を提案する。HiRISEカメラによる高解像度画像データと、機械学習（ML）ベースのアノーマリー検出手法の組み合わせにより、数億年残る可能性のある人工構造の定量的な上限評価を目指す。教師あり学習と教師なし学習の2つのアプローチを比較検討し、LiDARやレーダーなどの多様な観測データとの統合による行星科学への貢献も述べている。
